result.title: From Spectral Saliency to Finite Deletion: Evaluating Selective Language Model Edits
result.summary: Deleting singular components offers a precise way to remove a capability from a language model, yet the first-order spectral saliency used to rank components predicts only a local loss change, whereas deletion is a finite intervention. In this paper, we study how prediction error affects selective editing, where selective editing requires degradation of a target task while preserving others. We decompose the error into derivative transfer across item splits and nonlinear response along the deletion path. We establish that outer interval screening retains every feasible candidate when every candidate's intervals contain its finite validation loss changes on every task. We evaluate these effects using one answer-only negative log-likelihood objective for search, validation, and test, with disjoint calibration and evaluation masks. The primary configuration targets arithmetic in Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 while preserving code and question answering; extensions cover Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and reversed target roles. In the primary study, which deletes 1024 coordinates from a support of 7168, calibrated intervals cover 968 of 1024 evaluation masks. Outer screening reaches the direct-selected edit after 25 verification checks, whereas direct verification abstains at a 32-check cap, but it rejects 4 of 74 feasible masks. All three selected edits pass validation, yet only one meets every test constraint. Interval coverage, feasible-candidate retention, and independent test preservation are therefore distinct properties and require separate assessment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究语言模型选择性编辑：一阶谱显著度只能预测局部损失变化，而删除是有限干预。作者把预测误差分解为跨样本切分的导数迁移与删除路径上的非线性响应，提出外区间筛选来保留可行候选并做验证，在 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 上删除 1024 个坐标以削弱算术能力同时保留代码与问答。
AI.relevance_reason: 其区间覆盖、可行候选保留与独立测试保留三者分离的结论，以及验证预算（需 25 次校验、32 次上限下直接验证弃权）与局部代理在有限干预下失效的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容或支持组合的验证、停止决策与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。
